# shadcn Tailwind utilities

`shadcn-4.22.1.css` is the unmodified `dist/tailwind.css` asset from the
MIT-licensed npm package `shadcn@4.22.1`. Its SHA-256 is
`4c371f7a1ff5d219ae2f7ff28bd256b4346fd546fe46fbae22092e57db2f0fae`.

Only this stylesheet is used by Jarvis. Keeping its exact bytes here preserves
the existing UI utilities without installing the unused component-generation
CLI and its dependency graph. `apps/desktop/public/licenses/shadcn-LICENSE.txt`
preserves the copyright and permission notice and is copied into the desktop's
embedded frontend assets by Vite.

Upstream: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/shadcn%404.22.1/packages/shadcn

License source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/shadcn%404.22.1/LICENSE.md

When updating this asset, retain the applicable license, verify the source
identity and review the stylesheet changes explicitly.
